# Kavik Works
> Kavik Works (Robot Arms LLC) is a Denver business offering written workflow blueprints for small service businesses and property teams.

## Current offer
- Workflow Blueprint: $149 USD one time for one intake or follow-up workflow. Any applicable tax, scope, payment method, and delivery timing are confirmed before payment.
- Includes a workflow map, capture fields, routing rules, three editable templates, setup steps, a test checklist, and one clarification revision within seven days of delivery.
- AI-assisted preparation, checked against the customer brief. No call or account access required. No payment is collected on the website.
- This is a written plan. Installation, live inbox operation, and ongoing monitoring are not included. No customer results, conversion lift, or time savings are claimed.
- Current focus: quote requests, leasing inquiries, and shared administrative inboxes. Medical decisions, legal advice, financial decisions, tenant screening, and emergency dispatch are outside the offer.
